text: DENZA was a joint venture between BYD and Mercedes-Benz; after Mercedes-Benz sold its remaining 10% stake in September 2024, BYD fully owns the DENZA brand.
short: DENZA is wholly owned by BYD.

source.name: paultan.org: BYD now fully owns Denza after Mercedes-Benz sells off remaining 10% stake in NEV brand joint venture
source.quote: Mercedes-Benz has withdrawn from its Denza joint venture with BYD in China after selling off its remaining 10% equity
